name: Regulatory requirement gap worksheet
summary: Counsel and the compliance lead get one worksheet: each requirement counsel supplied, set beside the company's own policy and procedure passages, the controls its register maps and the evidence it has logged, with every missing link listed as a gap and a question. It never says whether the company complies.

sources.title: Its own published map of compliance work: the illustrative entry on comparing a requirement counsel has supplied with the company's recorded practice.
